vram.title: S-OS V-RAM Engine™
vram.subtitle: Breaking microcontroller memory limits. Run 8.0MB+ AI models and databases on a $1.50 ESP32 chip without physical PSRAM.
vram.esp32Desc: Full support for ESP32 Classic (WROOM, WROVER), ESP32-S3, and ESP32-C3. Tested on 8.0MB+ V-RAM with 0 errors and 43.54x compression.
vram.linuxDesc: The version for industrial Linux microcomputers (Raspberry Pi, Orange Pi, BeagleBone, Yocto edge gateways) is coming soon!
vram.matrixSubtitle: Select the optimal vram(blockSize, ramLimit, maxBlocks) parameters for your embedded application:
vram.modeDensityUse: Dataloggers, smart meters, dense databases, telemetry.
vram.modeCriticalUse: Time-critical robotics (LIDAR, autonomous navigation), real-time AI, framebuffers.
vram.modeMassiveUse: Chips with 16MB+ Flash (N16), large AI neural lattices, image caching.
vram.modeMicroUse: Sub-$1 MCUs, minimal heap environments, basic event counters.
vram.communityDesc: Max 512 KB V-RAM. Permanently free for evaluation, prototypes, and non-commercial open-source projects.
vram.proDesc: Unlocked V-RAM (up to 16MB+). Perpetual license for 1 product + 12 months of free updates and email support.
vram.growthDesc: Unlocked V-RAM (up to 16MB+). Perpetual license for fast-growing series + 12 months of support.
vram.enterpriseDesc: Royalty per unit (or $15,000/year). Includes Source Code Escrow, custom XOR security keys, and SLA support.
vram.faq1Q: Is the license a one-time payment or does it renew every year?
vram.faq1A: The Commercial Pro ($299) and Growth ($1,499) licenses are perpetual. They are paid as a one-time fee and grant you lifetime manufacturing rights for your device. The software in your devices never expires. The price includes 12 months of email support and free updates. After the first year, renewing support and updates is optional ($99/year).
vram.faq2Q: What happens if I manufacture more devices than the license threshold allows?
vram.faq2A: Production thresholds (Volume Caps) protect smaller startups and inventors. If your production exceeds 2,000 units per year, you simply pay the difference to upgrade to Commercial Growth or switch to the Enterprise OEM Royalty model ($0.15 per unit).
vram.faq3A: Clients receive a precompiled .a static library with symbols removed (stripped binary) and internal XOR model masking. Your source code and ours remain 100% secure from decompilation.
